Knight.name: Knight
Knight.effect: Move the robber to another tile, then steal one random resource card from an eligible player.

VictoryPoint.name: Victory point
VictoryPoint.effect: Adds one private victory point automatically. You do not play this card.

Monopoly.name: Monopoly
Monopoly.effect: Choose one resource. Collect all cards of that resource from every other player.

RoadBuilding.name: Road building
RoadBuilding.effect: Place up to two roads for free, following normal placement rules and piece limits.

YearOfPlenty.name: Year of plenty
YearOfPlenty.effect: Choose two available resource cards from the bank. You may choose the same resource twice if available.
